Class LobbyController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.GUI.controllers.LobbyController
All Implemented Interfaces:
UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
public class LobbyController extends Object implements UpdateHandler, MessageVisitor
Controller for the lobby screen, shown while players gather before a game starts. It lists the players that have joined, and once the lobby is full runs a short countdown before switching to the game screen.

As an UpdateHandler it receives server pushes and, as a MessageVisitor, dispatches each ServerMessage to the matching visit overload — here it reacts to lobby-state updates, errors, and game-aborted notifications. It also shows reconnecting / game- aborted overlays when the connection drops or the game can no longer continue.

    • visit

      public void visit(LobbyStateMessage message)
      Rebuilds the player list from the lobby update. When the lobby reaches the target game size it starts the start-of-game countdown; otherwise it shows how many players are still missing. Runs on the JavaFX thread.
      Specified by:
      visit in interface MessageVisitor
      Parameters:
      message - the lobby state (current players and target size)
